dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: Sea conditions are consistent and there are no other vessels in target waters... Hmmm... very suitable for kicking off "Vigilance at Sea"!

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Okay! Be sure to give it your all!

choices.text: About the difficulty of "Vigilance at Sea"...

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: I would like to ask you guys: how did you guys find the challenge?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon thought it wasn't too hard. This kind of test is a piece of cake for Paimon and {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Well, considering how formidable you two are, this sounds about right.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Thanks for your feedback. Now I know a little more! I'm going to have to think a little bit more about how to adjust the difficulty curve for both challenge and pass rate...

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: The four major certificates and the five minor certificates? Simple.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: The four major certificates consist of the "Fit for Sailing Certificate," the "Ship Maintenance Aptitude Certificate," the "Power Maintenance Aptitude Certificate," and the "Survivability at Sea Certificate."

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: The five minor certificates consist of the "Basic Safety Certificate," the "Lifeboat Certificate," the "Fire Safety Certificate," the "First Aid Certificate," and the "Monster-Precaution Certificate."

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: With all these certificates, a sailor is equipped to solve most of the problems of navigation.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Although the crew may not understand the principle of each request, they just need to remember the main points of the task and follow the instructions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This doesn't sound simple at all!

choices.text: And we still haven't gotten into the details yet...

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: No worries! With your talent, you can sail smoothly without having to bother with all the technical details!

choices.text: I should consult Beidou when I have the chance...

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Okay! The Captain is a bit of a straight shooter. You'll probably become experts after asking her!

choices.text: I need some time to prepare.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: I understand! You guys are measured and careful, so you guys might need some more time. I trust you guys!
